sampling.ddpm: Ancestral Gaussian posterior variance (DDIM eta=1), fresh independent pixel noise at each non-final step
sampling.ddim: Same diffusion weights and schedule, eta=0, no added sampling noise
sampling.diffusionSchedule: tau_i=0.98*(1-i/N), epsilon prediction; predicted clean image clipped to [-1,1]
sampling.flowSchedule: t_i=(i+0.5)/N, velocity prediction, no state clipping
sampling.scope: Sampler comparison using the two existing nine-generator checkpoints; PCA paths are nonlinear image embeddings, not pixel-space velocity vectors
